title: [SQS] No native way to set per-message DelaySeconds
author: AbhimanyuCODER
body_preview: ## Problem  AWS SQS supports `DelaySeconds` at two levels:  - **Queue level** — every message on the queue is delayed - **Message level** — only specific messages are delayed  kombu currently has no native way to set `DelaySeconds` at the message level.
